scope: Dynamic attribute grouping across the single-product edit form and the customer build flow: attribute_set_items.group_key drives labeled fieldset groups (admin product-model edit), and each build component renders as a labeled group with its resolved attribute definitions (customer sell flow).

businessFlow.subject: Attributes render in data-driven labeled groups instead of one flat list: the admin Desktop PC edit modal shows Processor/RAM/Storage/GPU/Power groups, and the customer Desktop PC build flow shows each component (CPU/Motherboard/RAM/Storage/PSU/GPU) as its own group with its attribute definitions, then a complete build selection enables the review step.

notes: Grouping is assembled server-side (catalog service listAttributeSetDefinitions/listCategoryAttributeSetDefinitions + sell-taxonomy service enrichEntries) and consumed by both admin and web — no component name is hardcoded in the UI. RAM Capacity (GB) and Storage Capacity (GB) are visually separated by their component groups.
